# PROJECT KNOWLEDGE BASE

**Generated:** 2026-04-28
**Stack:** Next.js 16.2.4 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 + Tiptap Pro

## OVERVIEW
Notion-like rich text editor built on Tiptap Pro with Yjs collaboration. App Router + custom component library (39 tiptap-ui components, 21 primitives, 12 node extensions).

## STRUCTURE
```
./
├── app/                    # App Router pages
│   ├── layout.tsx          # Root layout
│   ├── page.tsx            # Home (/)
│   └── notion-like/        # /notion-like/[slug] editor route
├── components/
│   ├── tiptap-ui/          # 39 toolbar button/popover components
│   ├── tiptap-ui-primitive/ # 21 base UI primitives (button, menu, popover...)
│   ├── tiptap-node/        # 12 Tiptap node extensions
│   ├── tiptap-extension/   # 5 custom extensions
│   ├── tiptap-templates/   # Notion-like editor template
│   ├── tiptap-icons/        # Icon components
│   └── tiptap-ui-utils/    # Floating element, suggestion menu utils
├── contexts/               # AI, collab, user contexts
├── hooks/                  # 15 custom React hooks
├── lib/                    # 3 tiptap utility files (tiptap-utils.ts is 640 lines)
├── styles/                 # SCSS partials (_variables.scss, _keyframe-animations.scss)
└── public/
```

## WHERE TO LOOK
| Task | Location | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Editor toolbar buttons | `components/tiptap-ui/` | 39 button/popover components |

## CONVENTIONS
- **Path alias**: `@/*` maps to project root
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + Sass (SCSS partials in `styles/`)
- **ESLint**: `eslint-config-next` with core-web-vitals + TypeScript
- **no `src/` dir**: flat directory structure

## ANTI-PATTERNS (THIS PROJECT)
- **No explicit anti-patterns marked** in comments (no DO NOT/NEVER/ALWAYS/DEPRECATED markers found)
- **No tests** — no test framework, no test scripts

## UNIQUE STYLES
- SCSS partials in `styles/` (non-standard — normally in `app/` or `src/`)
- Contexts at project root (non-standard for App Router — normally in `app/`)
- `lib/tiptap-utils.ts` is 640 lines — large utility file, consider splitting
- .npmrc contains TiPro custom registry + auth token

## COMMANDS
```bash
npm run dev      # Start dev server
npm run build    # Production build
npm run start    # Production server
npm run lint     # ESLint
```

## NOTES
- Tiptap Pro packages require auth token in `.npmrc` (registry: `https://registry.tiptap.dev/`)
- Collaboration uses Yjs (`yjs` + `@tiptap/extension-collaboration`)
- Floating UI (`@floating-ui/react`) used for popover positioning
- Radix UI + Ariakit + Base UI as underlying component libraries
